comparison.objective: Extract a jammed card with balanced two-hand pulling and resume printing, versus commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Synchronized gentle extraction to avoid tearing differs from fine tool insertion, rotary tuning, torque control, and repeated impact assessment.
comparison.success_condition: Card intact, removed and set down, then OK pressed versus safe repeatable stopping with no bottoming, rebound, overload, or drift.
comparison.reason: Bimanual force control is generic; the tested mechanisms and outcomes differ.
